-- 한글 경로 C:\검증
GRANT CONTROL ON ASYMMETRIC KEY::ak TO u;

-- 한글 경로 C:\검증
GRANT SELECT ON OBJECT::dbo.t TO u, [domain\u] WITH GRANT OPTION AS dbo;

-- 한글 경로 C:\검증
ALTER ASSEMBLY a FROM 'C:\clr\a.dll' WITH PERMISSION_SET = SAFE, VISIBILITY = ON, UNCHECKED DATA DROP FILE N'a.pdb', N'readme.txt' ADD FILE FROM 0x4D5A AS N'a.pdb';

-- 한글 경로 C:\검증
ALTER QUEUE dbo.q REORGANIZE WITH (LOB_COMPACTION = OFF);

-- 한글 경로 C:\검증
UPDATE STATISTICS dbo.t WITH RESAMPLE ON PARTITIONS (1, 3 TO 5), COLUMNS;

-- 한글 경로 C:\검증
COMMIT TRAN t WITH (DELAYED_DURABILITY = ON);

-- 한글 경로 C:\검증
ADD SENSITIVITY CLASSIFICATION TO dbo.t.c WITH (LABEL = 'Secret', RANK = HIGH);

-- 한글 경로 C:\검증
ADD COUNTER SIGNATURE TO dbo.p BY ASYMMETRIC KEY k WITH PASSWORD = 'x';
